label: D-FF/SR

semantics.notes: D flip-flop with asynchronous set and reset. s=1 → Q=1 immediately (async preset). r=1 → Q=0 immediately (async reset). When neither is active, Q captures D at rising clock edge. s=r=1 simultaneously is a forbidden combination (both async controls compete).

exportSupport.verilogNotes: asyncSRWrapVerilog: always @(posedge clk or posedge s or posedge r) begin if (s) q<=1; else if (r) q<=0; else q<=d; end. assign q_n = ~q; verilogWireOutputs=['q_n'].
exportSupport.vhdlNotes: asyncSRWrapVHDL: process(clk, s, r) if s='1' then q<='1'; elsif r='1' then q<='0'; elsif rising_edge(clk) then q<=d; end if; q_n <= not q;

testability.notes: Verify async set/reset override clock. s=1 → Q=1 regardless of clk. r=1 → Q=0 regardless of clk. Initial Q=0.

risks.description: s=r=1 simultaneously — both async controls active. Priority: s wins (preset has higher priority in most real 74HC circuits).

modelLimits: prevClk hidden state not exposed to STT.
